method.process: One fresh Node main-isolate child per size/branch; serial. Each branch has baseline/no-op/final snapshots after public build/verification/disposal. No live-engine root mutation.
method.collection: Three setImmediate/explicit-GC/25ms settling cycles per stage. Full heap dumping is intrusive. Only explicit component holders remain; owner/facade/root collection is separately witnessed.
method.cohort: Baseline own-data property/element/backing/string-parent reachability identifies a deduplicated node-ID cohort with overlapping role masks. Actual subsequent snapshot ID presence supplies disappearance observations. Baseline self-sizes of disappeared IDs are not total freed bytes or exact live-engine exclusive cost.
method.controls: Same-holder no-op interval and independent final noop branch; strong positive, released negative, shared object with external alias; surviving-ID size changes reported separately. Snapshot IDs are checked across controls and held roots.
method.boundaries: Node main isolate, source-phrase configuration only. No mutation/serialization peak, native allocator/RSS attribution, positions qualification, browser/worker/transport or AT claim. Raw dumps never enter the measured child as parsed objects.
method.childEnvironment: PATH/TMPDIR/LANG/LC_ALL only; 180-second owned-child watchdog. No credentials or unrelated browser/application data collected.

summary.meaning: Baseline selected-data node self-sizes whose IDs are absent in actual later snapshots. Not total freed allocator bytes, exact normal live-engine component cost or a peak. Membership overlaps; no-op churn, surviving size changes and release branches remain separate.
